name: ToolCall
label: Tool call
description: The record of one tool invocation, with its arguments and result behind a disclosure.

props.name: name
props.description: The tool that was invoked, shown in monospace.

props.name: status
props.description: Where the call has got to. Drives the colour, the indicator, and the default status text.

props.name: summary
props.description: One line describing this particular call, e.g. the target path or query.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the call took, e.g. "1.2s". Free text, so callers keep their own formatting.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: Override the status text shown beside the indicator.

props.name: open
props.description: Open state for controlled use. Pair with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires whenever the panel opens or closes.

props.name: actions
props.description:
Controls for a call awaiting a decision — allow, deny, always allow.
Rendered outside the collapsible panel, so approving never requires
expanding the call first.
